{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Group by patient_id and select the row with max sample_seq
df_deduplicated = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
severe_count = df_deduplicated['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_deduplicated)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Deduplicated patient count: {total_patients}")
print(f"Number with SEVERE severity: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction with SEVERE baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
